test_title: PYST 39: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.**

The construction ________ was far from his home.
solution: The correct answer is: **site** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • A homonym is a word that has the same spelling or pronunciation as another word but has a different meaning. • **Site **refers to a location or an area where something is built or situated. (वह स्थान या क्षेत्र जहाँ कुछ बनाया या स्थित हो) • In this context, the sentence talks about a construction site (a location where construction work is taking place). Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. **Complete sentence**: *The construction site __was far from his home.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Sight **refers to the ability to see or something that is seen. (देखने की क्षमता या कोई चीज़ जो देखी जाती है) • **Cite **means to quote or mention as evidence or an example. (साक्ष्य या उदाहरण के रूप में उद्धृत या उल्लेख करना) • **Cyte **is a term used in biology to refer to a cell. (कोशिका को संदर्भित करने के लिए जीव विज्ञान में प्रयुक्त एक शब्द) 35:T6e1, The correct answer is: "*The gist of the quote was that all reasonable men adopt themselves to the world.*"
